claims.assertion: Yazhi says authorities shape collective reality by validating agreements and excluding perceptions they reject.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She later says each consciousness has an equally valid personal reality; collective reality is negotiated agreements, not an absolute shared perspective.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says higher-density consciousness manifests ideas faster and perceives flexible, nonlinear event sequences; lower-density material agreements slow manifestation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She urges integrating alternate viewpoints without fixed attachments; each person may define reality but not impose it on others.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
